However, if the symlink's resolved path is outside of the root directory (which can happen when resolving a symlink that points to an absolute path), this will raise a `ValueError` because the relative path does not start with the expected root directory. 

Consequently, the error demonstrated by the test occurs because the method does not properly handle symlinks outside of the root directory.
